, the main contributions of this paper lie in that, the sliding mode control (i.e. the finite time reachable sliding surface function and SMC laws) for a class of singular systems with time delay and uncertain derivative matrix has been investigated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method is a novel and effective method for the SMC design problem of singular time varying delay systems with uncertainties in the derivatives.
the proposed theory can not only deal with the uncertainties in the derivative matrices, but also can guarantee the sliding mode dynamics with H performance and finite time reachability.

, for the first time in the literature, a new sliding surface function is proposed for singular systems with time delay and uncertain derivative matrix, and a new stabilization solvability criterion is proposed to determine the undetermined parameter in the sliding surface function, and two distinctive controllers are proposed for the singular systems with time delays and uncertain derivative matrix.

the uncertainties in derivative matrix are taken into account and the resulting sliding mode control laws are adaptive.
the sliding mode control law can be designed in the form of an adaptive robust control law.
